name: sportivea-zaloha
description: Sportivea Záloha — downloads Drive folders to a disk and sorts camera cards into a Google Drive folder

scripts.app: node scripts/bundle-ffprobe.mjs --require && electron-vite build && electron-packager . "Sportivea Záloha" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --app-bundle-id=cz.sportivea.zaloha --asar.unpackDir="node_modules/ffmpeg-static" --extra-resource=resources/bin --ignore="^/(src|tests|docs|scripts|resources|tsconfig.*|electron\.vite\.config\.ts|vitest\.config\.ts|\.gitignore|\.env.*|CLAUDE\.md|README\.md|node_modules/\.vite|node_modules/ffprobe-static/bin|\.superpowers|eval-results|dist)" && sh scripts/sign-and-zip.sh "dist/Sportivea Záloha-darwin-arm64/Sportivea Záloha.app" "dist/Sportivea-Zaloha.zip"
